newsitem.title: USA: Ralcorp to buy cracker/cookie manufacturer.
newsitem.headline: Ralcorp to buy cracker/cookie manufacturer.

text.p: Ralcorp Holdings Inc said Monday it reached a definitive agreement to purchase Wortz Co, a private label cracker and cookie business with annual sales of about $65 million.
Wortz has headquarters and plant operations in Poteau, Okla. It employs 425 people, Ralcorp added.
Terms of the acquisition were not disclosed. Ralcorp said an approximate equal combination of cash and debt will fund the purchase.
Ralcorp said Wortz will be operated as a part of its existing private label cracker and cookie subsidiary, Bremner Inc. Bremner's sales for the fiscal year ended September 30 totaled $77.8 million.
Both Wortz and Bremner produce a full line of private label crackers and a limited number of private label cookie products.

The two companies, however, service distinctly different customers, Ralcorp said. Grocery retail accounts are the majority of Bremner's customer accounts, while Wortz's customer base is predominately grocery wholesalers, it added.
Ralcorp said it expects to close the transaction within 60 days, pending appropriate government approvals.
The Wortz deal is the first acquisition for Ralcorp since its divestiture of its branded cereal and snack businesses and ski resort holdings. Those moves cut the company roughly in half.
In an interview last month, Ralcorp executives said the company was scouting for acquisitions.
